purpose: Coordinate the UI action that connects native PTY terminal state before starting an agent CLI session.

artifacts.retention_policy: Retained as the close-out evaluation report.
artifacts.cleanup_policy: No temporary artifact is created by this UI bridge.

resource_controls.timeout_policy: Existing Rust CLI sessions remain bounded by their existing session timeout logic.
resource_controls.cancellation_policy: Existing cancel_native_pty_terminal and cancel_cli_adapter_session actions remain available in RuntimeTerminalDrawer.
resource_controls.cleanup_policy: No new background supervisor, file pipe, or temp artifact is introduced.
resource_controls.orphan_process_policy: Existing Rust session disposal paths remain the owner of process cleanup.
resource_controls.backpressure_policy: Existing bounded PTY and CLI output buffers remain in use.

merge_strategy: No fan-out or merge gate is added. The bridge is a sequential UI action: PTY readiness gate first, then selected agent CLI session.
plan_evidence: The user asked to make terminal connection and agent function proper.
Existing Rust PTY and CLI session commands already provide the native process authority.
A renderer bridge can make the dependency visible without adding a new supervisor.
rollback_plan: Restore startSession and startNativePtySession inline logic from previous commit if needed.
Remove related test assertions and history/spec records.
notes: No stdout/stdin pipe edge is added in this slice; the bridge coordinates existing command invocations.
